create_filtered_ranking_evaluator: create a FilteredRankingEvaluator instance with a config schema and list of filter edge storage paths
build_links_map: build left-hand and right-hand side entity maps from edge storage paths for filtered evaluation
adjust_scores_for_filtering: adjust prediction scores by setting true positive margins to negative infinity to exclude them from ranking
review_filtered_eval_config_validation: review the FilteredRankingEvaluator config validation that enforces single entity type, non-featurized, and all negatives
summarize_filtered_ranking_evaluator: summarize the FilteredRankingEvaluator class for knowledge base completion datasets like FB15K and WN18
